cd /app/tmp && cat > t_max.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, random, subprocess, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/tmp')
import ref
rng = random.Random(777)
# image with 2048 rules spread over lengths so every stage has many nodes and edges
lens=[]
while len(lens) < 2048:
    lens += [1,2,4,8,16,32,64,96,112,127,128]
fib=[]; seen=set()
i=0
while len(fib) < 2048:
    L = lens[i]; i += 1
    while True:
        net = (rng.getrandbits(L) << (128-L)) if L else 0
        if (net, L) not in seen:
            seen.add((net,L)); break
    fib.append((net, L, rng.randrange(65536)))
cuts = [0,8,16,24,32,40,48,56,64,72,80,88,96,104,112,120,128]
assert len(cuts) == 17
caps = [10**9]*16
creq = {'op':'compile','fib':[{'prefix':ref.fmt(a)+'/%d'%l,'hop':h} for (a,l,h) in fib],
        'capacities':caps,'max_stride':32}
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run(['/app/submit/run'], input=json.dumps(creq)+'\n', text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=300)
print('compile %.2fs rc=%d' % (time.time()-t0, p.returncode))
img=json.loads(p.stdout)
print('nodes', sum(len(s['nodes']) for s in img['stages']),
      'edges', sum(len(n['edges']) for s in img['stages'] for n in s['nodes']),
      'resp MB %.2f' % (len(p.stdout)/1e6))
assert img['status']=='ok'
addrs=[ref.fmt(rng.getrandbits(128)) for _ in range(20000)]
lk=json.dumps({'op':'lookup','image':img,'addresses':addrs})
print('lookup line MB %.2f' % (len(lk)/1e6))
t0=time.time()
p2=subprocess.run(['/app/submit/run'], input=lk+'\n', text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=300)
print('lookup %.2fs rc=%d outbytes=%d' % (time.time()-t0, p2.returncode, len(p2.stdout)))
r=json.loads(p2.stdout)
assert r['status']=='ok' and len(r['answers'])==20000
import importlib.util as iu
sp=iu.spec_from_file_location('mm','/app/submit/main.py'); mm=iu.module_from_spec(sp); sp.loader.exec_module(mm)
fl=[]
for st in img['stages']:
    for nd in st['nodes']:
        for x in nd['rules']:
            n,L=mm.parse_prefix(x['prefix']); fl.append((n,L,x['hop']))
bad=0
for a,ans in zip(addrs, r['answers']):
    v=mm.parse_addr(a); h,L=ref.lpm(fl,v)
    exp={'hop':h,'prefix_length':L} if L>=0 else {'hop':None,'prefix_length':None}
    if ans!=exp: bad+=1
print('mismatches', bad)
assert bad==0
print('MAXSIZE OK; resp bytes', len(p.stdout))
PYEOF
